name: web_search
description: Search the web via the provider's built-in web_search tool. This is a provider-native tool executed server-side by OpenAI's Responses API (via the Codex OAuth or OpenAI Responses provider). Enable it by listing `web_search` in your agent's tools.md. The LLM decides when and how to query — Butterfly does not execute this locally. Intermediate search progress streams back as `web_search_call.searching` events the UI can render. For API-key-based (non-native) web search, use `web_search_brave` or `web_search_tavily` instead.
